question: Should OpenClaw adopt this Discord-specific seven-control progress configuration and persisted channel-lifecycle cleanup contract as a supported surface?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing mode and public configuration/API surface; correctness review cannot determine the permanent UX, defaults, or compatibility commitment without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt after narrowing risk
options.body: Keep the proposed feature after tracker serialization, conflict resolution, compatibility review, and exact-head proof are complete.

options.title: Ship a smaller contract
options.body: Reduce the initial controls and use fixed defaults to limit long-term configuration and upgrade burden.

options.title: Defer for lifecycle consolidation
options.body: Pause the feature until related yielded-parent lifecycle work defines the permanent completion semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt after narrowing risk
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed feature after tracker serialization, conflict resolution, compatibility review, and exact-head proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent channel lifecycle ownership makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the adapter and product-contract choice.
